performance.verdict: Meta dark 20 days; GBP and search holding but no paid pipeline.

findings.text: Meta spend has been $0 every day since 2026-08-07 — 20 consecutive zero-spend days, producing 0 leads in that window.
All 17 leads in the 28-day window arrived in the first 7 days (Jul 30–Aug 6) at $29.41 CPL; zero leads since spend stopped.
GHL shows 25 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments — intake pipeline completely stalled, predating the spend blackout.
Search clicks rose 39.3% (7d delta +39.29%) and GA4 sessions remain active (~55–90/day last 3 days), but no paid capture layer exists to convert that intent.
GBP actions fell 61.7% week-over-week; last 3 recorded days show 0, 0, 0 actions — possible profile suppression or data gap, not a paid media issue.

suggestions.text: Diagnose and restore Meta spend immediately — 20 dark days at $0 has killed all lead flow.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has been at $0 spend since August 7 — 20 consecutive dark days — producing zero leads after a working period that delivered 17 leads at $29.41 CPL (Jul 30–Aug 6). Check account-level payment failure, campaign rejection, or billing suspension and restore the account to the approved $65–75/day budget. Success is confirmed when the spend series shows a non-zero daily value and at least 1 lead registers within 48 hours of restoration. Resolve by 2026-08-28.

suggestions.text: Investigate GHL intake gap: 25 contacts, 0 opportunities created — leads are not becoming pipeline entries.
suggestions.monday_update: The GHL pipeline shows 25 contacts in the 28-day window but zero opportunities created and zero appointments booked — meaning leads arriving via Meta were never converted into trackable pipeline entries. Coordinate with Andrew (intake/Zoho) to identify whether the GHL automation or manual intake step is broken. Success is confirmed when new contacts produce corresponding opportunities within the same day of entry. Review by 2026-08-30.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions: 3 consecutive zero-action days — confirm data gap vs. real profile suppression by Aug 30.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have logged 0 for the last 3 recorded days, following a 61.7% week-over-week decline. This may be a data reporting gap rather than true suppression, given that search clicks simultaneously rose 39.3%. Log into the GBP dashboard directly and confirm whether calls and web clicks are genuinely zero or simply not pulling into the reporting feed. Re-check on 2026-08-30; if actions remain at 0 with confirmed data, escalate as a profile issue.
